functions.name: _capacity_ceiling
functions.input: zone, LGA name, lat/lng, lot area, heritage, width range, optional eligibility results
functions.output: (floor form, ceiling form, from_lmr, citation) to both callers
functions.if_none: None lat/lng gives empty exclusions; _realistic_forms fails safe to dwelling_house

functions.name: _ceiling_for_request
functions.if_none: missing lat, lng, zone or LGA name returns ceiling None plus a not-checked gap

values.if_missing: gap: Highest permitted housing form not checked: no LGA for this lot
engine runs without a width range, as the Site Report does when frontage is unavailable

queries.purpose: permitted forms for zone in this LGA (existing query, new caller)
queries.where_clause: lep_land_use_table by zone, LGA matched via _norm_lga
queries.if_wrong: wrong LGA name -> zero rows -> dwelling_house, never a denser form
